title: Normalize: lowercase + sort
prompt: Implement `std::vector<std::string> normalize(std::vector<std::string> v)` returning a copy with every string lowercased and the whole vector sorted lexicographically. Use `std::transform` in place (it may take and return `v` by value) plus `std::sort`.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Lowercase first, then the sort sees consistent case.

tests.name: mixed-case
